review: - This ID is tanky. Extremely tanky. He can soak in hits for days with an effective 800 HP pool, without considering his healing per turn. He doesn't offer much else besides tankiness, with just average clashes. If you just need a punching bag for the enemy to focus on while you're attacking, this ID is the one for you. - Notable E.G.O. Synergy - Dimension Shredder - The passive of Dimension Shredder lets him survive one more turn with 4 or more ampules. He will die the turn after though.
